title: Cascade via end-of-batch hook + sweeper, drop self-rescheduling watchdog
context: Route C emits subscription_type from the worker, but the inventory cascade needs a trigger. A self-rescheduling watchdog job was the first proposal; it risks unbounded reschedule loops and is hard to reason about.
decision: Synthesize Route C (worker emit) with an ASYNC cascade triggered PRIMARY by an end-of-batch drain hook in ProcessFeedQueueJob and backed by a daily sweeper command as the safety net. Drop the self-rescheduling watchdog.
consequences: Simpler, idempotent, kill-switchable (FEED_SUBSCRIPTION_CASCADE_ENABLED). Partial-drain race remains (documented, deferred to 1407 wire-back).
